item.title: Daily Minute — October 8, 2026
item.description: For sight can merely serve to offer you what you would have. It is impossible to overlook what you would see, and fail to see what you have chosen to behold. item.title: Lesson 108: “To give and to receive are one in truth.”
item.description: “To give and to receive are one in truth.” Vision depends upon today’s idea.The light is in it, for it reconciles all seeming opposites. And what is light except the resolution, born of peace, of all your conflicts and mistaken thoughts into one concept which is wholly true?
